Title: Public Preview: Azure Cache for Redis now supports up to 30 shards

Body.Content:
Azure Cache for Redis now supports clustered caches with up to 30 shards which means cache instances can now store more data and your applications can be more scalable as your workload grows. For caches with two replicas, shard limit will be 20 and with 3 replicas, shard limit will be 15.  

Learn more.
